quote.text: Use thyself even unto those things that thou doest at first despair of. For the left hand we see, which for the most part lieth idle because not used; yet doth it hold the bridle with more strength than the right, because it hath been used unto it.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Just as the unused hand grows strong only through practice, so does your capacity to nurture and guide your child flourish through persistent, hands-on involvement.
    • Embrace even the moments that seem fraught with difficulty, for these challenges refine your skill as a caregiver, teaching you patience, empathy, and resilience.
  • Leadership:
    • Real leadership is honed in the disciplines of daily challenges; by engaging fully even in tasks you initially doubt, you build a reservoir of strength and reliability.
    • Trust in your ability to lead grows with experience—each task handled, however insignificant it may seem at first, contributes to a robust character that inspires and guides others.
  • Product Management:
    • Much like mastering a neglected hand strengthens your grip, consistently tackling the overlooked aspects of product development can lead to unexpected insights and innovation.
    • Failure in early stages is not an endpoint but a stepping stone; by re-engaging with challenging problems, you build a more resilient, user-centered product and grow as a resourceful manager.
